responsibility: Defines the main target configuration macros for the Visium port. This header supplies driver, preprocessor, assembler, linker, ABI, register/debug, alignment, jump-table, multilib, and assembly-formatting definitions, exposing the target-wide compile-time policy that connects GCC’s generic backend interfaces to Visium-specific object format, built-in macros, calling/debug conventions, and emitted assembler syntax.
same_name_distinction: The target configuration header for the Visium port: unlike visium.cc it declares compile-time macros and assembler/debug/driver conventions rather than implementing hook logic, unlike visium.md it does not define RTL patterns, and unlike visium.opt it fixes backend-wide policy and emitted syntax instead of defining user-selectable target switches.
